overview: The Gokturk Khaganate was the first Turkic empire to use the name Turk, controlling the Silk Road from Manchuria to the Black Sea. They created the first Turkic writing system and maintained complex diplomatic relations with China, Persia and Byzantium.

items.text: The Orkhon script, the first Turkic writing system, carved on stone monuments.
Buddhism, Christianity and Manichaeism also present among some groups.
Controlled major sections of the Silk Road, facilitating East-West trade.
Diplomatic missions sent to Tang China, Sasanian Persia and Byzantium.
The name Turk first appears in historical records with this empire.
The Orkhon inscriptions remain crucial sources for early Turkic history.

fall.text: The Uyghur tribes defeated the Gokturks and established their own khaganate in 744.
